paragraphs.text: The Onslaught block is the eighth block , consisting of the large expansion Onslaught ( ) and the two small expansions Legions ( ) and Scourge ( ). The block came out in 2002–2003.
The theme of the Onslaught block is creature types , " typal ".

Onslaught is the first block to introduce at least one new keyword in each set, a trend which all blocks since have followed. It introduced amplify , double strike , morph , provoke , storm , and typecycling as new keywords; keyworded the fear mechanic first introduced in Alpha ; and reused cycling . Double strike and fear were made evergreen .

In 2007, numerous cards with only a class creature type such as the Cleric , Soldier , and Wizards were retroactively given additional species creature types during the Grand Creature Type Update to be more consistent with the " species/class model ". In most of these cases, the additional creature type was Human . This, by and large, did not cause significant changes to this block.
